ठपनीयप्रश्न: ṭhapanīya-praśna(-śabda), in the alphabet list in the school scene, to furnish a word with initial ṭh, LV 127.17, a question that is to be rejected, left unanswered; ṭhapanīya = Pali id. = Skt. (BHS) sthāpanīya; see sthāpanīya-vyākaraṇa.
ठपेति: ṭhapeti (= Pali id.; see sthapayati, § 38.52), places, sets, establishes: ṭhapetu Gv 34.24 (vs).
ठम्भन: ṭhambhana or °nā (= Skt. stambhana; from this root Pali records only forms with th-, as thambhanā, and so Pkt. except Gr. and Lex. ṭh-, see Sheth), restraint, constraint, (hostile) immobilization: avamānanā, tathā vimāna ca ṭhambhanāś ca (…mama nāmadheyu smara-māṇa labhanti mokṣam) Gv 213.25 (vs).
